clue.text: Semitic lawyers given a rise

indicators.note: in a down clue a rise means the letters are read upwards, so this pair is turned round

parts.note: the Bar is the collective name for barristers

explanation.surface: Jewish or Arab legal professionals have been given a pay increase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given a rise' turns BAR plus A upwards, giving the reversed run.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabic peoples belong to the Semitic family of languages and peoples, alongside Hebrews.

clue.text: Son stowed away in plane for a bit of fun

indicators.note: a stowaway hides inside a craft, so one letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: a jet is a jet-powered plane

explanation.surface: A boy hid on an aircraft as a prank.
explanation.definitionFit: A joke made in play is a light piece of amusement.

clue.text: Not in favour of setting a trap

parts.note: a gin is a snare or trap for animals

explanation.surface: Someone opposes the laying of snares.
explanation.walkthrough: AGIN is a dialect form of 'against'; 'setting' is only a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: Dialect 'against', meaning opposed to something.

clue.text: Eats up bacon first in European port

indicators.note: first places the pork word ahead of the other piece

parts.note: ham is cured pork, like bacon

indicators.note: in a down clue 'up' means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: grub means food, eats

explanation.surface: Someone wolfs down bacon before anything else while in a continental harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eats' is a noun meaning food, not a verb; 'up' turns that food word upwards in this down clue, and 'first' puts the bacon word ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamburg is a major German seaport on the Elbe.

clue.text: Gin rioters dished out when merrymaking

indicators.note: something dished out is handed round and scattered, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Gin is served to rowdy types at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Roistering means noisy revelry, enjoying oneself boisterously.

clue.text: Escort gave weapons to train official

parts.note: to arm someone is to give them weapons, so armed
a guard is the railway official in charge of a train

explanation.surface: A railway employee is issued firearms to act as protection.
explanation.definitionFit: An escort of soldiers carrying guns protects a person or a shipment.

clue.text: Dawn gets a cheap ticket

definitions.meaning: daybreak is when daylight comes back
a discounted rail ticket, out and back on the same day

explanation.walkthrough: Dawn is read playfully as the comeback of daylight. A British DAY RETURN is a reduced-fare rail ticket for travelling there and back in one day.
explanation.definitionFit: Daybreak is light coming back, and a same-day there-and-back rail fare is a cheap British ticket.

clue.text: It may sell or give away

definitions.meaning: a store is a place that sells goods
slang for betraying someone to the police, to inform on them

explanation.definitionFit: A store sells goods, and British slang uses the same word for informing on an accomplice.

clue.text: Resort to Italian-Jewish quarters for Italian food

parts.note: a spa is a resort town with springs
ghetti is the Italian plural of ghetto, the historic Jewish quarter

explanation.surface: Someone takes refuge in the Jewish districts of Italy to eat Italian cuisine.
explanation.walkthrough: GHETTO is Italian (the Venice Ghetto), so its Italian plural GHETTI is fair here.
explanation.definitionFit: Long thin pasta strings, a staple dish of Italy.

clue.text: Cook found it in small bottle with some culinary herb

indicators.note: small means the word is cut short, keeping just its start

parts.note: any means some, as in 'have you any'
bay leaves are a cooking herb

explanation.surface: A chef discovered something inside a tiny jar of seasoning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cook' looks like a chef, but it is Captain James Cook. 'small' cuts BOTTLE down to BOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Captain James Cook landed at this inlet near Sydney in 1770 on his first voyage.

clue.text: Part of the circular circumference

parts.note: a curved section of the boundary line of a round figure

explanation.definitionFit: In geometry a curved segment of a circle's perimeter has this name.

clue.text: Part of an artificial sole added to boot

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A piece of a man-made shoe bottom is attached to a boot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to boot' is an idiom meaning in addition, not footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean in addition, besides, furthermore.

clue.text: Drill uniform

definitions.meaning: a drilling platform or apparatus, as for oil
an outfit or style of dress

explanation.definitionFit: An oil-drilling installation shares its name with a set of clothes or kit.

clue.text: Let off the fare for the Styx ferry

parts.note: Dis is the classical underworld, the destination of Charon's ferry across the river Styx
a charge is a fee or fare

explanation.surface: The boatman waives the price of crossing to Hades.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'the fare for the Styx ferry', the price of a trip to Dis, the Roman underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: To fire a gun or release someone is to let them off.

clue.text: Go to prison and put a man on the rack

definitions.meaning: slang for serving a term inside

definitions.text: put a man on the rack
definitions.meaning: to stretch someone on a torture rack

explanation.definitionFit: A stretch is slang for a prison sentence, and the rack literally stretches its victim.

clue.text: Serviceman gets no backing, but has to persevere

parts.note: a soldier is a member of the armed services

indicators.note: backing here means going in reverse, so this little word is turned round

explanation.surface: A soldier gets no support yet must keep going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' looks like support, but it turns NO into ON.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going doggedly despite difficulty, as a soldier would.

clue.text: A fine old book may be bigoted

definitions.text: A fine old book may be
definitions.meaning: a quality antique volume may have leather covers
narrow-minded and set in one's opinions

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a volume with leather covers; figuratively rigidly narrow-minded.

clue.text: Hastened to greet young Ted

parts.note: hi is a greeting
Ed is a short form of Edward, as is Ted

explanation.surface: Someone hurried to say hello to a boy called Ted.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic past tense meaning hurried or went quickly.

clue.text: Ordered to admit everything in a poem

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: bade is the past tense of bid, ordered
all means everything

explanation.surface: Someone was told to confess all in verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admit' looks like confess, but here means let in: the word for everything is let into the past tense of bid.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballade is a verse form of three stanzas and an envoi, a type of poem.

clue.text: Cut down by a short illness

parts.note: curt means brief, short
an ail is an ailment

explanation.surface: Someone was laid low by a brief sickness.
explanation.definitionFit: To curtail is to reduce or shorten.

clue.text: He loses his footing and footwear

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who slips loses his footing, and a soft shoe for wear at home is also so called.

clue.text: A case for sewers

parts.note: sewers here are people who sew, not drains, and the case holds needles

explanation.walkthrough: 'sewers' wants to be drains; read it as people who sew.
explanation.definitionFit: A small ornamental case for needles and thread.

clue.text: Sense of possession long in existence

indicators.note: in places the word 'long' inside the other

parts.note: being means existence

explanation.surface: Feeling owned has lasted a long time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possession' tempts as the whole definition, but the sense is the feeling of fitting in; 'in' puts the length word inside existence.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging is the feeling of fitting in or being owned by a group.

clue.text: Gullible fool turned up in Moscow department store

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: a mug is a dupe, an easily fooled person

explanation.surface: A dupe appeared at a Russian shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' looks like arrived, but reverses MUG. GUM is the famous store on Red Square.
explanation.definitionFit: The State Department Store on Red Square in Russia's capital.

clue.text: Self-love is exemplary love

parts.note: e.g. means for example
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Vanity is a model sort of affection.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-esteem or conceit, an inflated sense of self.

clue.text: I get embraced by the woman's successor

indicators.note: being embraced is being held inside, so one letter goes within

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman

explanation.surface: A person hugged by a woman becomes her heir.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get embraced by' places I inside HER.
explanation.definitionFit: One who inherits or follows on.

clue.text: Major changed PM posture

indicators.note: changed signals the letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: The Prime Minister altered his stance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Major' looks like John Major the Prime Minister, but it is the definition. 'changed' rearranges PM + POSTURE.
explanation.definitionFit: Highest or most important, foremost.

clue.text: Complain about a form of transport

definitions.meaning: trains, as in travelling by train

explanation.definitionFit: To protest angrily, and also travel by train on tracks.

clue.text: Race for the trees

definitions.meaning: a famous flat horse race run at Epsom
plural of a hardwood tree with acorns

explanation.walkthrough: The Oaks is an English classic horse race for fillies at Epsom Downs.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic fillies' horse race at Epsom shares the name of acorn-bearing timber.

clue.text: Huge measure of wine topping a fish

indicators.note: topping in a down clue puts the wine measure above the other piece

parts.note: a tun is a large cask, an old wine measure

explanation.surface: A big serving of wine is poured over a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A large ocean food fish of the mackerel family.

clue.text: Pole is able to measure radiation

parts.note: S stands for south, one of the poles
can means is able

explanation.surface: A Polish person is able to check radiation levels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person; it is a magnetic pole, S.
explanation.definitionFit: A scanner detects and measures radioactive emissions.

clue.text: What an engraver does while drowning

definitions.meaning: cutting dies for stamping coins or medals
read as 'dies sinking', perishing as one goes under

explanation.definitionFit: Cutting stamping moulds is engravers' work, and read as two words it describes perishing underwater.
